_meta.contract: Committed BEFORE any Phase-2 eval run (owner doc §7: 'Write these thresholds to a file first; do not adjust after seeing results'). Changing a value after a run is a protocol violation; tests/test_d10_thresholds.py pins every value exactly so any edit is loud and must move file + pin together in a reviewed diff. No Phase-2 eval run existed at registration (the built recall.py 8-query experiment is the harness seed, not the eval).
_meta.amendment: DEC-006 2026-07-10 (PR #318): eval corpus widened to graph + docs + digest; the bar below is UNCHANGED by that amendment

significance.rule: BOTH must clear before any delta is called real

dense_anti_pattern_auto_reject.consequence: auto-reject the dense lane (it hurts the majority category)

validity_gate.on_fail: eval INVALID - re-pool; never report results from an invalid run

dense_precondition.source: REAL rows of the query log (P2-0a, docs/quality/recall_queries.jsonl); classification unrunnable until 30 real queries accrue - never sampled from memory

corpus_config_recording.rule: report per corpus-config, never pooled; a digest-absent run certifies the degraded graph+docs mode only (DEC-006)

tuning_frozen.rule: no grid search at n=60 (owner doc §4); revisit only at 500+ labelled queries
